title: 冲浪狗狗与牵手睡觉的海獭
pdf: https://michael-podcast-1513696684.cos.ap-chengdu.myqcloud.com/vol14/Vol14_晚读讲义_冲浪狗狗与牵手睡觉的海獭_v2.pdf
pdfName: Vol14_晚读讲义_冲浪狗狗与牵手睡觉的海獭_v2.pdf

blocks.en: Hello, young explorers, and welcome back to Michael's Morning Listening! This is our fourteenth show together! Today we are going to the beach — and the surfers there are not people. They are dogs on surfboards! Later, we meet an animal that holds hands while it sleeps. Ready? Let's dive in!
blocks.title: 开场白
blocks.cn: 你好，小小探险家们，欢迎回到 Michael 的早听晚读！这是我们在一起的第十四期节目啦！今天我们要去海边——而且那里的冲浪选手根本不是人，它们是站在冲浪板上的狗狗！等会儿，我们还要去认识一种睡觉时牵着手的动物。准备好了吗？跳进水里吧！

blocks.en: On a sunny beach in Huntington Beach, California, crowds are cheering at the ocean. Why? A dog is surfing! This is the Surf City Surf Dog competition, where dogs ride real waves. Big dogs, small dogs, long dogs, round dogs — all standing on surfboards, ears flying!
blocks.title: 冲浪狗狗大赛
blocks.cn: 在加利福尼亚州亨廷顿海滩的一片阳光沙滩上，人群正对着大海欢呼。为什么呢？一只狗狗在冲浪！这就是“冲浪城冲浪狗”大赛——一场狗狗冲真浪的真实比赛。大狗、小狗、长狗、圆狗——全都站在冲浪板上，耳朵在风里飞！

blocks.en: The rules are simple. Each dog gets twelve minutes to catch its best five waves. Judges watch: How long is the ride? How brave is the dog? A good surf dog rides the wave all the way to the sand, and walks off like a superstar. Every dog wears a life jacket, so everybody stays safe.
blocks.title: 冲浪狗狗大赛
blocks.cn: 规则很简单。每只狗狗有十二分钟，冲上自己最好的五道浪。评委会仔细看：这一浪冲了多久？狗狗有多勇敢？一只好的冲浪狗会稳稳地冲完整道浪，一路冲到沙滩上，然后像超级明星一样走下板。每只狗狗都穿着救生衣，所以大家都很安全。

blocks.en: The biggest superstar is a dog named Sugar. Sugar was a rescue dog, found on the street. But on a surfboard, she is pure gold: she has won this competition five times! Her paw prints are in the concrete of the Surfers' Hall of Fame — the first dog to receive this honour.
blocks.title: 冲浪狗狗大赛
blocks.cn: 最大的明星是一只叫 Sugar（小糖）的狗狗。Sugar 是一只被救助的狗，曾经流浪街头。但在冲浪板上，它就是纯金的冠军：它已经赢过这场比赛五次了！它的爪印被印进了冲浪名人堂的水泥地里——Sugar 是第一只获得这份荣誉的狗狗。

blocks.en: And it is not only about winning. Some dogs surf in pairs, two friends on one board; some surf with their humans. The party raises money to help dogs find new homes. Sun, waves and happy dogs: what a day!
blocks.title: 冲浪狗狗大赛
blocks.cn: 而且比赛不只是为了赢。有些狗狗成对冲浪——两个好朋友站同一块板；有些和主人一起冲。这个大派对还会筹钱帮助狗狗找到新家。阳光、海浪和快乐的狗狗：多棒的一天！

blocks.en: Now let's float away to the quiet water where sea otters live. Sea otters spend their whole lives in the ocean. They eat, play — and yes, sleep — in the water, floating on their backs like little boats.
blocks.title: 牵手睡觉的海獭
blocks.cn: 现在我们漂离海滩，来到海獭生活的安静水面。海獭一辈子都生活在海里。它们在水里吃、在水里玩——对，也在水里睡，仰面漂着，像一只只小船。

blocks.en: But if you fall asleep on the sea, the waves will carry you away! Sea otters have two clever tricks. Trick one: hold hands. Otters sleep in groups called rafts, paw in paw, so nobody drifts away. One raft can hold dozens of otters, all hand in hand.
blocks.title: 牵手睡觉的海獭
blocks.cn: 可是，如果你在海上睡着，海浪会把你冲走！海獭有两个聪明的办法。办法一：牵手。海獭成群睡觉，这样的一群叫作“獭筏”，它们爪子牵着爪子漂着，谁也不会独自漂走。一个獭筏可以有几十只海獭，全部手牵着手。

blocks.en: Trick two is even smarter. Near the shore grow forests of kelp, rooted in the sea floor. An otter wraps kelp around its body like a rope; the kelp is an anchor, holding it in one place.
blocks.title: 牵手睡觉的海獭
blocks.cn: 办法二更聪明。岸边长着巨藻森林，根扎在海底。海獭把巨藻像绳子一样缠在身上，巨藻就像一只锚，把它稳稳地固定在一个地方。

blocks.en: And the babies? A newborn pup cannot swim or dive, so it rides on its mother's belly while she floats on her back. She grooms its fur — the thickest coat of any animal on Earth — to keep it warm. When Mother dives for food, she wraps her baby in kelp first — like parking a tiny boat. And thanks to conservation, otters are coming back to these waters.
blocks.title: 牵手睡觉的海獭
blocks.cn: 那宝宝怎么办呢？刚出生的海獭宝宝不会游泳、也不会潜水，所以它就骑在妈妈的肚子上，妈妈仰面漂着。妈妈会给它梳理毛发保暖——海獭的毛是全世界所有动物中最厚的。妈妈潜水找食物时，会先把宝宝用巨藻缠好——就像停好一条小船。而且多亏了保护工作，海獭正在重新回到这片水域。

blocks.en: Here's today's idiom: "in the same boat." You and your friends are in one small boat, and the waves grow bigger. You are safe together — or wet together! Nobody can climb out alone. It means you share one problem and help each other. Like surf dogs and humans: if a wave wins, everybody gets wet! Example: "When rain stopped our picnic, we were all in the same boat, so we played games inside."
blocks.title: 今日俚语
blocks.cn: 今天的俚语是“in the same boat”（在同一条船上）。你和朋友们坐着一条小船，海浪越来越大。你们要么一起安全，要么一起湿透！没人能独自爬出去。它的意思是：你们面对同一个问题，要互相帮助。就像冲浪狗狗和它们的主人：如果海浪赢了，大家一起湿！举个例子：“下雨搅黄了我们的野餐，我们都在同一条船上，所以改在屋里玩游戏。”

blocks.en: Let's think about our stories. Dogs rode real waves; otters held hands in their sleep. Now, two questions for you. First: if you could teach a dog one sport, which sport would you choose? Second: otters hold hands so they never drift apart. On a big adventure, whose hand would you hold? Talk about it with your family!
blocks.title: 结束语与互动问题
blocks.cn: 我们来想想今天的故事。狗狗冲了真正的海浪，海獭牵着手睡觉。现在，轮到回答两个问题。第一：如果你能教一只狗狗一项运动，你会选哪一项？第二：海獭牵手是为了永远不漂散。如果去大冒险，你会牵住谁的手？和家人聊聊吧！

blocks.en: That's all for today, young explorers. On the waves or on the water, good friends stick together — in the same boat. See you tomorrow morning!
blocks.title: 告别
blocks.cn: 今天的节目就到这里啦，小小探险家们。在浪上还是在水上，好朋友都会紧紧在一起——同在一条船上。明天早上见！

quiz.title: B. 单项选择（Single Choice）
questions:
How much time does each dog get to catch its best five waves?
A. Five minutes
B. Twelve minutes
C. One hour
D. Two minutes

What is special about Sugar?
A. She is the biggest dog on the beach
B. She is the fastest swimmer
C. She has won the competition five times and her paw prints are in the Hall of Fame
D. She surfs without a board

Why do sea otters hold hands when they sleep?
A. To keep their paws warm
B. So nobody drifts away alone
C. To play a swimming game
D. To catch more fish

What does "in the same boat" mean?
A. Sharing the same problem and helping each other
B. Riding a boat together for fun
C. Living in a house near the sea
D. Swimming in the same race

children.text: it rides on its mother's belly
这句话其实是两个小句子用
拼起来的：前半句讲“做不到的事”，后半句讲“所以怎么办”。读长句先找连接词，就找到了骨架。
这类否定词后面，连接两个并列成分要用
（肯定句才用 and）。记法：否定 or、肯定 and。
（所以、因此）：前面是原因（宝宝不会游泳也不会潜水），后面是结果（它骑在妈妈肚子上）。
while she floats on her back
表示“与此同时”：宝宝骑着、妈妈漂着，两个画面是同时发生的。读到
，脑子里要同时摆出两个画面。
宝宝不会游也不会潜（原因，cannot…or…）→ 所以骑在妈妈肚子上（so 引出结果）→ 而妈妈同时仰面漂着（while 摆出同时画面）
。一句话装下了海獭一家的睡觉智慧。
"Each dog gets twelve minutes to catch its best five waves."
"She has won this competition five times! Her paw prints are in the concrete of the Surfers' Hall of Fame — the first dog to receive this honour."
"paw in paw, so nobody drifts away"
— holding hands keeps the raft together.
"It means you share one problem and help each other."
